steps.text: Bring a shovel, a rope, a pick, and invisible or stealth rings for the fire devils.
steps.source: Required Equipment: Shovel, Rope, Pick, Invisible spell or Stealth Rings for Fire Devils

steps.text: Go down into the small cave east of Mount Sternum, and down another level.
steps.source: Go to the small cave east of Mount Sternum, and go down. You will be in a small room, go down another level.

steps.text: Pick a hole just to the south-west and go down it.
steps.source: In this room, you will need to pick a hole just to the south-west, as indicated on the map. Go down the hole.

steps.text: A fire devil. Follow the passage around to the west and go down.
steps.source: In this room is one Fire Devil. Follow the passage around to the west, and go down another level.

steps.text: Fire devils: in the south-west corner pick another hole and go down.
steps.source: On this level, there will be 5 Fire Devils. Head to the south-west corner of the room, and pick another hole, then go down.

steps.text: Lava all around and many fire devils: the spike sword is in the body hidden behind a pillar.
steps.source: The reward is inside a body that is hidden behind a pillar.
